Episode 122. The Emperor (1)
Fortunately for the falling Hwangwan, Jin recognized the imperial palace as enemy territory.
His senses were heightened. Thanks to that, Jin could detect something unusual happening from the high point of the palace.
'Human?'
No matter how high the tower, the fall is instantaneous.
There was no time to worry about who the falling person was or what the situation was before and after.
His body moved reflexively.
Crack-!
Power erupted from his swollen thigh, causing the white paved road to sink and crack, and Jin's body shot into the air like an arrow released from a bowstring.
It was too fast for the nearby imperial guards to block, even without any preparation. The guards could only stare at Jin's retreating figure with wide eyes.
And the emperor, seeing Jin approach the tower, grinned, revealing his teeth.
'It's close, but I can catch it.'
At that moment, familiar and sharp metallic sounds rang in Jin's ears.
The sound of swords being drawn, dozens of them at a glance.
This was the imperial palace.
In other words, the most heavily guarded space in the world. Both visible and invisible, there were swords protecting the emperor everywhere in the palace.
From the moment Jin arrived, the hidden imperial guards were on high alert.
Even if it was to save a falling person, as long as this was the imperial palace, the guards had a duty to restrain Jin.
All movements in the palace had to be universal and reasonable. A 'sudden leap' was considered an act threatening the emperor's safety.
Shaaak-!
The leaping guards' swords rushed towards Jin. Jin, without drawing his sword, spun his body in mid-air to avoid the attack.
However, no matter how skilled Jin was, he couldn't dodge all the guards' attacks with his bare body. Especially in the desperate state of floating in the air.
Several blades grazed Jin's body as they passed. While multiple wounds were made at once, and blood splattered noisily, they were all relatively minor cuts.
With such injuries allowed, there was a gap. Jin managed to catch Hwangwan, who was falling just before.
"Are you alright?"
At the same time, the swords of the falling imperial guards were aimed at Jin from all directions.
"Stop!"
"This is the imperial palace, Jin Runcandel."
Jin didn't answer but checked the condition of the person he had saved.
'It's a Hwangwan.'
Jin could tell by the attire. The prominent scar on Hwangwan's neck caught his eye, and he immediately recognized that the wound was intentionally inflicted to prevent him from speaking.
At this time, there were only two reasons why such a Hwangwan would fall from the palace tower.
Suicide or imperial command.
All other possibilities were too unlikely.
Although Jin had moved reflexively with the thought that a person was dying.

From the moment Jin jumped, he thought the latter possibility was more likely. That the emperor had given the order to jump. It would be too contrived for someone's suicide to coincide with his own visit.
Jin helped Hwangwan up and looked up at the top of the tower. The emperor's figure was not visible, and the slow closing movement of the tower window felt as if someone's lips were curling upward.
It was obvious why the emperor had forced Hwangwan to jump. He intended to observe how Jin would react.
'How arrogant.'
Jin shrugged his shoulders and glanced at the imperial guards.
"Get out of the way, I just received the emperor's greeting."
At those words, a coldness settled in the guards' eyes, but far away, a group of servants hurriedly ran over, shouting.
"Guards, stop!"
"He is the emperor's guest, how dare you show such rudeness!"

The emperor had invited Jin as a top guest and provided him with appropriate attendants. They were also taken aback by Jin and the emperor's sudden actions, but unlike the guards, they quickly understood the emperor's intentions and responded accordingly.
"I am the chief attendant Barkam. On behalf of the guards, I apologize for the rudeness."
Jin locked eyes with Barkam for a moment and said this.
"Let's go to a more comfortable place."
The word "throne room" was left out, but Barkam and the attendants could not help but feel embarrassed as they understood Jin's meaning.
Since the other party was rude first, Jin decided not to bother with courtesy. There was no one higher in status than a Runcandel rider outside of Runcandel.
"I will lead you to His Majesty."
Jin followed Barkam and the attendants for about an hour through the palace.

The palace interior exhibited the epitome of splendor as expected from the imposing exterior. As the third most powerful group in the world, following Zifal and Runcandel, and the unique empire on the continent, it was a fitting luxury.
Soon they reached the Dragon Hall, where the inner palace guards and close guards blocked Jin's path.
"Hand over your weapons."
"No."
"What... do you mean?"
"It means I intend to meet the emperor with my weapons."
"Huh?"
"Aren't the palace's best warriors right next to the emperor anyway? If it's really not acceptable, I'll just leave."
This was the first time such a case had occurred since the current emperor's enthronement.
As the inner palace guards and the royal guards were considering how to respond, a eunuch's faint voice came from inside the Dragon Hall.
"J-just, let him in!"
The thin, shiny curtain blocking the entrance to the palace was drawn, and dozens of palace maids appeared from somewhere, laying down small, colorful pieces of cloth like long carpets.
As they moved, the maids collected the cloth pieces from the places where Jin had passed and laid new pieces on the untouched floor.
When they reached the end of the cloth pieces, the maids retreated into the darkness on both sides, and the majestic throne, which seemed endlessly high, came into view.
Regardless of their status, those standing there should have bowed deeply, but this did not apply to the people of Runcandel and Zipple.
'Amir Vermont...'
Jin briefly thought about the emperor's name.
He was Kasimir's older brother and, in Jin's previous life, the original owner of Muta's Rune, a man who encouraged human experimentation.
'In my previous life, I only thought of him as someone who was good at walking a tightrope between Runcandel and Zipple. In reality, most of the people think of the current emperor that way.'

The emperor's external first impression was far from someone who would be good at walking a tightrope. A prominent nose, thick eyebrows, and dignified, shining eyes. He looked like a general who had gained enlightenment through countless wars.
As Jin stared up at him, the emperor spoke first.
"You've had a hard time coming here, Jin Runcandel."
"Your Majesty must have had a hard time returning to your seat after such a rough welcome."
The emperor smiled at the provocative remark.
"Were you offended?"
"Yes, I was."
"You're just as fiery as I've heard. I was simply curious about you."
"Do you mean you threw a eunuch to his death just to see my reaction?"
"That's right. Although you're passionate, you're more soft-hearted than I thought. How can you only look one step ahead?"
The emperor tilted his head and continued.
"The eunuch you saved is a criminal. He dared to covet a palace maid, so I took away his voice a few years ago and personally made him live a miserable life as a laughingstock."
"Is that so?"
"Why would you risk the lives of innocent guards to save a man worse than a sick dog?"
Clang, clang!
From the darkness on both sides of the palace, iron bars opened, and the sound of chains dragging was heard.
The guards who had first saluted Jin walked out from the darkness, battered and bloodied from the brutal flogging they had received on their way to the palace.
The emperor continued with a smile.

"Because they couldn't stop your impulsive behavior, these guards were flogged, dismissed, and forced to return all the salary they had earned during their service. Although it's a small punishment compared to not stopping a threat to me, it's an unspeakable tragedy for them."
Jin remained expressionless as he looked at the guards.

"In other words, by trying to save the trash, you have ruined these people and their families. Moreover, this is the imperial palace, my land... Your actions were a grave breach of etiquette from the very beginning. No matter what happens here, you have no right to stop it. You have interfered with my execution."
As the emperor spoke emphatically, Jin nodded.
"You make some interesting points."
"Ask for my forgiveness now."
"And there's one thing you're mistaken about."
"Mistaken?"
"Do you think I was unaware of the breach of etiquette when I tried to save the attendant?"
The emperor's eyes narrowed.
"I don't agree with the sophistry you've laid out, but I didn't even bother to calculate any of that in the first place. I had a strong feeling that you were testing me, so I simply acted on a whim."
"Hahaha..."
"Do you really think the Emperor Vermont can test the Rider of Runcandel?"
The emperor's laughter ceased.
However, it wasn't due to showing displeasure. Rather, the emperor seemed to be genuinely intrigued, his eyes shining with interest.

"There are many swords here that can kill you. Even if I wield one of those swords and kill you, Runcandel will not retaliate greatly. It's as if I've removed a jagged stone on their behalf. The justification is more than enough."
It wasn't entirely wrong.
If the emperor killed Jin, Joshua and his forces could easily cover up the incident to a reasonable extent. As long as Jin's body was returned.
"I've experienced situations like this before in my life... and there's something I always say."
"What is it?"
"Give it a try, if you're confident."
Suddenly, the emperor stood up and exclaimed in admiration.
"Indeed, there's no way the man who broke the Sword Garden not long ago would find this place difficult. I have no choice but to salute your courage!"
He seemed genuinely pleased, clapping his hands with a flushed face.
"Release the guards, reinstate them, and return their gold crowns."
As the inner guards took the guards away, the emperor smiled again.
"Now I think I know a little about you."
"I still don't know much about the emperor."
Jin and the emperor's gazes collided.
"It'll be good to learn more over time. Today, I have called you to bestow a reward, so can't our relationship develop in a positive way?"
"What will you give me?"
"Power."
The emperor looked down at Jin and continued.
"I will give you the power to swallow Runcandel and, furthermore, to stand against Zipple."
